snippet.title: All 12 Months! 📅 Riddle #20 Answer + Riddle #21: Which Way Does the Rooster's Egg Roll? 🐓 #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's riddle: some months have 31 days, some have 30. How many months have 28 days? Answer: all 12! Every month has at least 28 days. February is the only month that can have JUST 28 (29 in a leap year).

Now Riddle #21: Person 1 watches a rooster climb to the very top of a barn roof. The rooster lays an egg right on the peak. Will the egg roll down the left side or the right side? Person 2 says left. Person 3 says right!

Comment 1, 2 or 3. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. ☀️

#riddle #brainteaser #puzzle #trickquestion #riddles #shorts
